<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 3:3">Targ. Y. Num. III, 3</cite>. Targ. O. a. Y. I ib. XXXII, 14; a. fr.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ top <he>אמרין ליה תלמידוי</he> his disciples said to him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1:14">Y. Snh. I, 18ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>תלמידי</he> (prob. to be read <he>תלמידוי</he>); a. e.
